title: Blimpin' Ain't Easy, but It Just Got a Lot Easier

body_markdown:
- *Easily purchase tires on Goodyear.com and get them installed in your driveway or at Goodyear Auto Service and Just Tires stores*
- *Available only from Sept. 15 through Oct. 15, 2026*


AKRON, Ohio


, Sept. 15, 2026


/[PRNewswire](http://www.prnewswire.com/) / -- As summer rolls to an end and weather gets more unpredictable, make sure your favorite ride is ready with a new set of Goodyear tires (NASDAQ: GT), which could land you in the Goodyear Blimp if purchased in the next 30 days.


Goodyear's new "Golden Ticket" sweepstakes will give a lucky Goodyear enthusiast and guest the opportunity to win a once-in-a-lifetime flight on the iconic Goodyear Blimp.


From Sept. 15 through Oct. 15, fans can enter the sweepstakes by purchasing a set of four Goodyear tires on[Goodyear.com](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4773823-1&h=3649568658&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.goodyear.com%2Fen-us%2Fshops&a=Goodyear.com) or through[Goodyear's Auto Service](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4773823-1&h=2918493985&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.goodyear.com%2Fen-us%2Fshops&a=Goodyear%27s+Auto+Service) and[Just Tires stores](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4773823-1&h=1456237497&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.justtires.com%2Fen_US%2Ftire-stores&a=Just+Tires+stores) and submitting the entry form[here](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4773823-1&h=224451076&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.goodyear.com%2Fen-us%2Fblimp%2Fgolden-ticket-sweepstakes&a=here) . The randomly selected winner will receive a blimp flight certificate for two passengers that can be redeemed at any of Goodyear's three U.S. airship bases in Akron, Ohio, Carson, California or Pompano Beach, Florida.


No purchase is necessary. See Official Rules[here](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4773823-1&h=224451076&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.goodyear.com%2Fen-us%2Fblimp%2Fgolden-ticket-sweepstakes&a=here) for further details and an alternative mode of entry. Terms and conditions apply.


Whether drivers are looking for sporty, year-round performance from the Goodyear Eagle F1 All Season, all-terrain capability and on-road comfort from the Goodyear Wrangler Outbound AT, all-weather confidence from the Goodyear Assurance WeatherReady 2, EV-focused performance from the Goodyear ElectricDrive 2, or another tire from Goodyear's full portfolio of tires for today's vehicles, eligible purchases made during the sweepstakes period can help keep them moving and give them a chance to take flight on the world's most legendary aircraft.


"We've been known to say, 'Blimps Are Cool. Buy Tires,' and this sweepstakes brings those two things together in a memorable way," said David Cichocki, Managing Director, Americas & Chief Sales Officer, at Goodyear. "Whether you purchase from the comfort of home through Goodyear.com or visit a Goodyear Auto Service or Just Tires location, you'll be driving on tires you can brag about and have the chance to experience something truly iconic -- a ride on the Goodyear Blimp."


Available in select markets nationwide, consumers purchasing tires at Goodyear.com can also choose[Goodyear Mobile Garage](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4773823-1&h=432393170&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.goodyear.com%2Fen-us%2Fmobile-garage&a=Goodyear+Mobile+Garage) at checkout, which sends an outfitted van and Goodyear-certified technician to the buyer's selected location – work, school, home, or more - on the scheduled appointment day to install their tires and perform other tire and service needs.


Fans of the Goodyear brand and blimp can stay up to date on the latest activities, announcements and more by following @Goodyear and @GoodyearBlimp on social media.


**About The Goodyear Tire & Rubber Company** Goodyear is one of the world's largest tire companies. It employs about 63,000 people and manufactures its products in 48 facilities in 19 countries around the world. Its two Innovation Centers in Akron, Ohio, and Colmar-Berg, Luxembourg, strive to develop state-of-the-art products and services that set the technology and performance standard for the industry. For more information about Goodyear and its products, go to[www.goodyear.com/corporate](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4773823-1&h=3145322431&u=https%3A%2F%2Fedge.prnewswire.com%2Fc%2Flink%2F%3Ft%3D0%26l%3Den%26o%3D4743907-1%26h%3D3980913255%26u%3Dhttps%253A%252F%252Fc212.net%252Fc%252Flink%252F%253Ft%253D0%2526l%253Den%2526o%253D4491765-1%2526h%253D1797373052%2526u%253Dhttp%25253A%25252F%25252Fwww.goodyear.com%25252Fcorporate%2526a%253Dwww.goodyear.com%25252Fcorporate%26a%3Dwww.goodyear.com%252Fcorporate&a=www.goodyear.com%2Fcorporate)
